goal: The storage-layout migration never asks the user to commit: migrate --storage-layout commits its affected paths itself, and Enrollment and intent author commit a migration_uncommitted diff and continue instead of stopping.

acceptance.assertion: Meet T4 and D14 in docs/specs/run-only-gates.spec.md: imm-kernel migrate --storage-layout ends in the ready state with every affected diff automatically committed under the D8 subject. A cleanup-only pending diff produces exactly one commit; a full legacy import commits preserved evidence before retiring sources and commits the resulting cleanup separately, retaining the existing data-protection order. Every commit contains only its affected paths, unrelated dirt is byte-identical afterwards, no next-action text asks the user to commit, and recovery_required and migration_blocked_active still fail closed.

Meet D14, D15 and BR-3: on a migration_uncommitted layout, intent author and Enrollment commit the affected paths and continue to their normal result. A migration_required layout is still not converted implicitly by intent author, and the Planner contract tells the Planner to run imm-kernel migrate --storage-layout itself and retry without interrupting the user. The packaged Claude bundle matches its source.
